# Parallel Cookbook

> Recipes and full-stack examples for building with Parallel APIs.

## Quick orientation

- Recipes live in `recipes/<slug>/`. Each has a `recipe.json` with metadata.
- `docs/task-best-practices.md` — read before writing any Task API schema.
- `context/task-library.json` — example Task specs for schema design.
- `context/sdk-types.d.ts` — full TypeScript SDK types.
- `AGENTS.md` — full agent orientation guide.
- `CONTRIBUTING.md` — PR checklist and template reference.

## Parallel APIs

- Task API: structured web research with schema-defined outputs
- Search API: LLM-optimized web search returning relevant excerpts
- Extract API: targeted structured extraction from URLs
- FindAll API: entity discovery at scale
- Monitor API: change detection over time
- Ingest API: bulk data ingestion
- MCP: Model Context Protocol integration
- OAuth Provider: PKCE-based auth for apps
